race.comment: STEEL KNIGHT (4) is the one to beat despite a plain ninth in BM72 grade at Newcastle first-up, with his proven record at this track and distance the strongest pointer now he is second-up. His best 1000m form is good enough for this and the stable has a strong profile at this venue. SOUL LADY (2) resumes off a solid winter campaign, including a narrow Nowra second on heavy ground and a BM82 fourth at Wagga. Her run here in the Camarena when fresh last campaign was solid and if she can be at that level here, then she'll be right in the mix again. HELLUVA TEEN (9) has been close at both recent runs, leading and sticking on for third at Wagga after another third at Corowa, and she brings reliable 1000m form. WONDERFUL MISTAKE (10) is showing some ability early in her career and can't be left out on resumption.
